title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Global Resourcing Talent and Reward Management
description: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of Global Resourcing, Talent and Reward Management.
longDescription: The aim of this course is to provide a comprehensive understanding of the relationship between talent performance and reward management, the performance and reward management system, effective talent sourcing and retention, employee reward management, and payment systems, and an introduction to talent management. The course will equip participants with practical tools and strategies to design and implement effective performance and reward management systems that attract, retain, and motivate talented employees. Participants will also learn how to develop and implement talent management strategies that align with the goals of the organization and create a positive work environment.
courseDetails: Reward management System. Design of reward system. Reward management process. Relationship with strategic planning. Impact on employee and organisational performance. Benchmark Data. Barriers to effectiveness. War for Talent and talent Types. Competency-based Management. Four Stages of Competence. Competency Architecture. Recruitment and Retention. Succession Planning and its Process The Fundamental Purposes of Reward Management. Influential Theories of Work Motivation and their implications for the Design of Reward Systems. Individual performance-related pay (PRP) systems. Contemporary approaches in Reward Management. The concept, purpose and benefits of Talent Management. The Financial Value of Talent Management. The Talent Management Process. This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of Global Resourcing, Talent and Reward Management. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Relationship between Talent Performance and Reward Management: Understanding the Performance and Reward Management System: Effective Talent Sourcing and Retention: Employee Reward Management and Payment Systems: Introduction to Talent Management:
